correctness.rationale: Derived exact coalition worth from q=floor(2(s+t)/n): 0 for q=0, max(s,t) for q=1, and only grand coalition q=2 with max(3a/2,a+b,3b/2). Marginal contributions in uniformly random player order give two exact binomial-weighted Shapley sums; efficiency follows. Independent Fraction implementation exhaustively tested every 49 unordered nonempty party-size profiles n=2..14 and all 1512 coalition types (s,t), reproducing exactly one negative slack: (a,b,s,t)=(6,8,6,1) with gap 83/858, phi_A=7127/9009 and phi_B=6947/6006. Code directly derives rather than trusting claimed logs; this exhaustive finite proof covers the entire finite threshold, not n>14.
